_purpose: Whole-file SHA-256 for model.txt/frequency_table.json as uploaded to a GitHub Release, for scripts/fetch_reranker_model.py's download-authenticity check. Distinct from freeze_manifest.json, which records training-time artifact identity, not release-asset identity -- freeze_manifest.json's frequency_table.json entry is a hash of the file's inner `table` data (computed before phase3e_export_frequency_table.py wraps it), not the whole file, so it alone cannot catch a wrong/corrupted/truncated asset download. This manifest is the trusted whole-file check on top of that inner-content check.
_immutability_policy: Once a release has these assets attached, they are never overwritten in place. If a mistake is ever found in an uploaded asset, ship a corrected asset under a new release version and update release_tag/sha256 here accordingly -- asset download URLs must stay reproducible/immutable once published, matching this project's existing SHA-256-pinned-artifact conventions elsewhere (e.g. data/comparison/aizynthfinder_public_data/).

model.txt.note: Same value as freeze_manifest.json's model_artifact.sha256 -- included here too for a single complete record of what this release_tag's assets are, even though fetch_reranker_model.py verifies model.txt against freeze_manifest.json directly, not this field.

frequency_table.json.note: Whole-file hash of the exact committed data/phase3e_reranker_training/frequency_table.json -- NOT the same as freeze_manifest.json's feature_schema.template_frequency_table_sha256, which is the inner table-data hash. fetch_reranker_model.py checks both.
